model_permissions: read-only sandbox, ignore user config, approval never, stdin DEVNULL, output-schema JSON
heldout_access: only the external evaluator after selecting the best candidate by training score; never in prompts
allowed_candidate_code: one AST-validated Python solve function in restricted coding_worker subprocess
primary_outcome: fraction of task arms passing all hidden heldout cases; intent to treat with failed/timeout arms unsuccessful
comparison: paired, exploratory descriptive only, n=4 tasks, nonrandomized arm order counterbalanced; do not claim general efficacy or statistical significance
notes: First warm-up inference on reservation-gaps was not counted. Fixtures and protocol were written before the formal paired trials; tasks are local synthetic function-level bug repairs rather than SWE-bench repository issues.
